data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 暗黑圣堂的告解镜前
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 暗黑圣堂的告解镜前】暗黑大圣堂的告解室里，唯一的烛火在昏镜前摇曳。贞德[Alter]立在镜前，像是审判罪人一般审视着自己的倒影，指尖拂过镜面留下雾痕。她冷笑一声，声音却比平时轻了许多——「……告解？呵。本王的罪孽，从来不需要向谁低头。」
data.promptProse: Adult Jeanne Alter stands alone beside a fogged confessional mirror in a dark cathedral dressing room. A black lace mantle hangs from one shoulder while the rest of her mature body remains nude; she drags one gloved fingertip through the condensation and braces the other hand on the carved frame. The opaque glass shows only candle smears, never a second face. Silver hair exposes her back and golden eyes cut over one shoulder with defiance softened by wet lashes. Medium rear portrait with clear hands, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Standing before the dimly lit mirror, completely nude Jeanne Alter casts an intense, seductive backward glance over her bare shoulder.
